title: Relay phase trace: make enter()'s frozen guard observable, or drop it
outcome: Either a test fails when MailboxRelayPhaseTrace::enter() stops ignoring phases after freeze(), or the guard is removed as unobservable, with a comment saying why. Today snapshot() and a repeat freeze() both return the frozen copy, so removing the guard only changes live state that nothing reads.
acceptance: Relay phase trace: make enter()'s frozen guard observable, or drop it is done
